name_in_paper: flow cytometric characterisation of B cells and plasma cells

evidence.section: Flow cytometric characterisation of B cells and plasma cells
evidence.quote: The cells were analysed on a Beckman-Coulter Cyan Flow Cytometer with 9-colour parameters.
Serum samples collected at days 0, 28 and 56 were assessed for human SBA activity against serogroup A (F8238) and serogroup C (C11).
Memory B cells were assessed using cultured ELISpot performed on blood samples collected at days 0, 28 and 56.
The real-time PCR (RT-PCR) used the Platinum® SYBR® Green SuperMix-UDG detection system (with ROX) on a StepOnePlus™ instrument (Thermo Fisher scientific, Massachusetts).
